summary: Enforce provider-declared JSON Schema before response acceptance

delivery.outcome: Enforce the schema already declared by response_format=json_schema before accepting a model answer, across ordinary and adaptive execution. Existing clients should receive schema-based failover without adding quality_schema.
nonGoals: No provider wire changes, automatic schema inference, model order, credentials, arbitrary execution or remote schema retrieval.
No Supervisor source change; its current json_object request remains a separate consumer integration dependency.

architecture.decision: Derive a local acceptance gate from the raw schema in an existing json_schema descriptor at the common route attempt boundary, before provider invocation. Compose it with any explicit quality_schema/task predicate so neither contract can silently replace the other. Reuse the independently published bounded offline 2020-12 validator.
architecture.rollback: Revert this acceptance wiring through independent publication; no data migration.

validation.evidence: Valid JSON violating the declared wire schema causes model-scoped rejection and bounded fallback, with original wire fields preserved.
Invalid descriptors fail before provider invocation; explicit local and wire schemas both apply; ordinary, explicit-model and adaptive paths retain their constraints.
